edit.why: The diode-connected mirror transistor (M6 in IMAGE 1) has its gate tied to its drain, which is the I_Bias node.
The source of this transistor goes to ground; the pipeline wrongly put it on the gate line.
The gate line running to the second mirror transistor is the same node as the diode-connected drain/gate.
This is the NMOS tail current source (M5 in IMAGE 1), with its source and body at ground.
